description: The canonical review-findings shape, shipped at a stable path so a sidecar review lens can be given -S without the caller inventing a schema. Kept structurally identical to review_fanout.js FINDINGS_SCHEMA: the two engines return the same object, so a consumer never branches on which one produced it. NO length caps and no maxItems on `findings` -- a capped array silently DROPS findings, and per-field caps once rejected complete deliverables outright (feedback_schema_caps_must_not_invalidate_delegate_work). The budgets in each description are soft targets the schema does not enforce. Every key here must be a standard JSON Schema keyword: the CLI validates --json-schema in ajv STRICT mode and rejects an unknown one outright, so a `_comment` key fails every dispatch before the child starts.

report.description: lens-level table or census the brief asked for, markdown; null when the brief asked for none

mandates.description: outcome per mandate key (findings, clean or not-reached)

gaps.description: one entry per must-read item the seat did not read, with its closed reason

file.description: location as "path/to/file.cs:line" — include the line number; an anchor for humans, never finding identity (the engine assigns F-ids, and two findings may share one anchor)

description.description: the defect, briefly enough to act on without the rationale; no restatement of the rationale

old.description: minimal excerpt to locate/replace — the smallest span that makes the edit unambiguous, never the whole method or file

new.description: literal replacement text for `old` at the same granularity for FIX; a fix the seat can only describe is a PLAN with `scope` and `options` (orchestrator_action_protocol §Finding Schema)

refuting.description: true when the finding says the plan misstates a cited source

evidence.description: The evidence contract's machine twin (reference/evidence_contract.md owns the semantics; tools/verify_claims.py is the one executable implementation). A claim's `evidence` is a list of items, each exactly one of four kinds, one item per source: never several sources joined in one string, never a re-rendered structure, never a `memory:` prefix. Every key here is a standard JSON Schema keyword, so the CLI's strict validator accepts it.

oneOf.description: A quote from a local file. VERIFIED when the quote (case-folded, in-order `...` gaps allowed, a leading `path:N:` or `N:` grep prefix stripped) occurs in the file; UNVERIFIED when the file is readable and lacks it or does not exist; UNCHECKED when the file cannot be read.

file.description: repository-relative or absolute path, optionally with :N or :N-M; the line range is reported, never decisive

quote.description: the file's raw bytes, copied verbatim; one source per item

oneOf.description: The stdout of a read-only git command from the allow-list (git grep, ls-files, ls-tree, log, show, branch, check-ignore, cat-file, rev-parse, diff --stat or --name-only, status --short), run without a shell from the repository root. VERIFIED when stdout holds the output, or when output is empty, stdout is empty and every pathspec the command names matches a tracked path. Any other command, a shell metacharacter, an unlisted flag or a timeout is UNCHECKED. One leading `git -C <dir>` (an existing repository-relative directory, where the command then runs) and `check-ignore --no-index` are allowed.

command.description: one git command, no pipe, redirect or substitution

output.description: a verbatim run of the command's stdout, or the empty string for an absent claim

oneOf.description: The owner's verbatim words. VERIFIED when an owner turn of the session transcript holds them (an AskUserQuestion answer is an owner turn when the item also carries its `question`; a runtime envelope is not), or when a row of the named task record holds them and still resolves. A delegate-recorded, missing or unresolved row, or an unreadable transcript, is UNCHECKED.

question.description: the AskUserQuestion question the owner answered; required when the quote is a picked option label

task.description: a task record id whose condition rows may hold the words when this session's transcript does not

oneOf.description: A quote from an external page. A fetched artifact (fetch_source.sh manifest) is checked like a file; without one the item is UNCHECKED.

url.description: the page the quote was read from

artifact.description: local path of the fetched bytes

rationale.description: why it is wrong and what breaks, briefly; cite the rule or invariant rather than re-deriving it
